canDoWhy: Talk to Wulf Wild-Blood in Skaal Village on Solstheim; he tells you about his missing brother.

starts.where: Skaal Village on Solstheim; his home is Wulf Wild-Blood's House
starts.how: Talk to Wulf. He tells you his brother Torkild ran off years ago and may have become a werebear, and asks you to keep an eye out for him.

takesYou.why: Torkild is said to be wandering Solstheim; find and deal with him
go back to Wulf with the news

rewards.what: Wulf teaches you to fight better (the journal says so; which skill isn't in these files)
rewards.when: when you tell Wulf what happened to Torkild

closes: Torkild dies: the quest has you kill him, as a man or after he turns into a werebear
The quest fails if Wulf dies before you bring him the news

people.role: gives the quest; lives in Wulf Wild-Blood's House in Skaal Village

people.name: Torkild
people.role: Wulf's brother, wandering Solstheim; may turn into a werebear

unsure.why: Torkild has no placed person record in these files, so where on Solstheim he turns up isn't known.

Wulf is placed in his house. His own work package runs from 8 am for 12 hours at a spot the files don't name, so by day he is somewhere in or near Skaal Village rather than indoors. An earlier package has him building with other Skaal while something isn't disabled, probably tied to the Dragonborn main quest.
No reward item or script property is listed. The only reward is the journal line saying Wulf 'taught me how to fight better'; which skill goes up, and by how much, isn't in these files.
The quest also has a Journal and a Journal Chest, probably Torkild's, but these files don't place them or give their text.

These files tie Kolbjorn Barrow to the quest Unearthed (and its dig-site tracking quests), and Raven Rock Mine to The Final Descent. Reaching Ahzidal or Zahkriisos may mean doing those quests first, but nothing here says this quest checks for them.
No reward is listed.

unsure.why: The Delayed Start add-on gates Eltrys, Weylin, Margret and the market traders on one of its own globals. That global's value and what changes it aren't in these files, so a player can't be told what unlocks the scene.
Eltrys has a package to walk up to you once the attack is over, and the journal says you 'received a note'. Whether he hands the note over or it reaches you some other way isn't spelled out.

TheChoiceIsYours.esp adds a condition to four of the opening lines that checks Eltrys isn't at his smelter work, which runs from 7 am for 12 hours. So he may only take up the matter outside those hours.
The objective numbers put Thonar before Nepos. In play, Weylin's note points to 'N' and that leads to Nepos, so the order you meet them may differ from this list.
The script holds a leveled reward and gold, but the files don't say which step pays them out, and the quest ends with Eltrys dead.
